decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 1, 2, 3, 4B, 5BReceived: 7th September 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The existing garage to the rear of the property should be demolished prior to commencement of construction of the single storey rear extension

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority. The proposed window to the side elevation shall be obscure glazed below 1.70 metres from ground level and shall not be replaced by clear glazing without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of garage and store and the erection of a single storey rear extension to the house.
